{"question": "What is the original meaning of the word Norman?", "sources": [{"source_id": "squad-context-c14cb52e0d8ca7b881d0d20570d1ad267d085b79af6bdbfb72715ac665d264d0", "text": "Closely related fields in theoretical computer science are analysis of algorithms and computability theory. A key distinction between analysis of algorithms and computational complexity theory is that the former is devoted to analyzing the amount of resources needed by a particular algorithm to solve a problem, whereas the latter asks a more general question about all possible algorithms that could be used to solve the same problem. More precisely, it tries to classify problems that can or cannot be solved with appropriately restricted resources.
